headline: Pfeiffer outscores the top of the table
dek: Pfeiffer has scored 52 goals across all matches, more than table leaders NC Wesleyan and Southern Virginia combined. That attack has carried the program to ten wins, four draws, and four losses while allowing 21 goals, yet both lower-scoring rivals sit ahead of it in conference play.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Overall scoring volume divides the conference sharply, yet the highest-scoring programs have not controlled the table; Southern Virginia sits near the top despite scoring seventeen goals and conceding 24.
